metadata.method_name: SAM vs SGD calibration on a small CNN (Fashion-MNIST)
metadata.description: Plain SGD (momentum 0.9) and sharpness-aware minimisation (SAM) on the same base optimiser, matched architecture, data split, batch size, schedule and seeds. Hyperparameters chosen on validation only. Reports accuracy, ECE (15 bins), ACE, NLL, Brier, AURC, temperature-scaled SGD control, paired t-intervals over 5 seeds with Holm correction, and a compressed-schedule training-length check.

chosen_hparams.selection_rule: minimum validation NLL of the final-epoch model, seed 100

decisions: no cut: full grid fits the timing gate

metadata.split: 60k official training images: fixed 50k train / 10k validation (seed 0); 10k official test set used only in final evaluation

deviations: Post-epoch-40 extension to 60 epochs is not applied; the eval-mode training loss is recorded in each run's metrics.json (needs_extension_check) and reported as an under-convergence flag.
Holm correction is applied over the plan's family only; the training-length contrast and the AURC SAM vs TS-SGD contrast are reported uncorrected.
Seed bootstrap is a check only (5 seeds give 3125 unique resamples).
MPS kernels are not bit-deterministic; seeds fix initialisation and batch order, not floats.
limitations: One dataset (Fashion-MNIST), one small CNN, no ImageNet-scale or CSAM runs (Tan et al. 2025 scope).
Five paired seeds: low power; a non-significant result is weak evidence of no difference.
Hyperparameters tuned on one seed (100) and the final-epoch validation NLL only.
